rationale: Adjusted the status/command invariant entry so it no longer reads as if a recovery without a command always gets state.NOOP(): startPhase1 substitutes NOOP only when the batch it is handed is nil, and the recorded empty-slice path hands it a non-nil empty slice, which is exactly why that path can leave an instance at PREACCEPTED with a command list of length zero. The rest of the entry - the command-carrying writers, the acceptor status claim and its conditions - is unchanged, and the empty-slice entry that records the exception keeps its own text.

knowledge.statement: Every writer of an instance status at or above PREACCEPTED in the captured package installs a non-nil command in the same step: startPhase1 builds the instance with the batch it was given (and state.NOOP() only when the batch it is handed is nil, which an empty non-nil slice is not - the case the recovery entry records, where the instance still ends up with a command list of length zero), handlePreAccept sets inst.Cmds = preAccept.Command in the same branch that sets PREACCEPTED or PREACCEPTED_EQ, handlePreAcceptReply and handleTryPreAcceptReply copy lb.cmds, which those paths always hold, and handleTryPreAccept sets the command before setting PREACCEPTED. Acceptors that never pre-accepted report status NONE or PREACCEPTED(_EQ) and never ACCEPTED, because handleAccept records only bal, vbal, seq and deps.
knowledge.conditions: The captured snapshot's epaxos package with Thrifty on and IsLeader false, for any instance of any row (epaxos/epaxos.go:751-779, 796-833, 895-960, 1204-1313, 1316-1352).
